messages.content: If I see a person commiting murder. What should i do?

### Explanation
If you witness a person committing murder, it is essential to understand the legal concept of Qatl-e-amd, which refers to the intentional act of causing death. According to the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860, Qatl-e-amd is defined in Section 300, which states that whoever, with the intention of causing death or bodily injury, does an act that is likely to cause death, commits Qatl-e-amd. The punishment for Qatl-e-amd is outlined in Section 302, which includes death as Qisas, death or imprisonment for life as Ta'zir, or imprisonment for up to 25 years. As a witness, it is crucial to report the incident to the authorities and provide any relevant information to aid in the investigation.

### Cited Statutory Sources
- Pakistan Penal Code, 1860, Section 300
- Pakistan Penal Code, 1860, Section 302

ACT: Pakistan Penal Code, 1860
SECTION/ARTICLE: 300
TITLE: Qatl-e-Amd:
CHAPTER: INTRODUCTION
============================================================

Qatl-e-Amd:
Whoever, with the intention of causing death or with the intention of
causing bodily injury to a person, by doing an act which in the ordinary course of nature is
likely to cause death, or with-the knowledge that his act is so imminently dangerous that it
must in all probability cause death, causes the death of such person, is said to commit
qatl-e-amd.
ACT: Pakistan Penal Code, 1860
SECTION/ARTICLE: 302
TITLE: Punishment of qatl-i-amd:
CHAPTER: INTRODUCTION
============================================================

Punishment of qatl-i-amd:
Whoever commits qatl-e-amd shall, subject to the
provisions of this Chapter be:
(a)
punished with death as qisas;
(b)
punished with death or imprisonment for life as ta'zir having regard to the facts and
circumstances of the case, if the proof in either of the forms specified in Section 304 is not
available; or
(c)
punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to
twenty-five years, where according to the injunctions of Islam the punishment of qisas is
not applicable
